## Summary

Describe the desired outcome in one or two sentences.

## Problem

What is missing, painful, or currently impossible?

## Scope

- What should be included?
- Which crate, app, or user-facing area is affected?

## Out of scope

What should explicitly not be included in this issue?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the expected behavior, API, interaction model, or examples.

## Testing and verification

- [ ] Add or update focused tests.
- [ ] Verify relevant light/dark or visual states, if applicable.
- [ ] Run formatting, checks, and relevant tests.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Observable requirement.
- [ ] Observable requirement.
- [ ] Documentation or architecture updates are made if needed.
